title: The Colour-Coded Monday
skyStory: A sliver of moon, nine percent lit, slips into Virgo with a label maker. It is going to organize the end of the month whether anyone likes it or not. Mercury, ruler of Virgo, hands it a set of coloured pens. The constellations are being sorted by brightness and then by mood. Saturn is thrilled. Mars has hidden in the coat closet.

reading: Monday, Virgo moon, last week of September. You will feel an unusual craving for order: tidy desk, clean inbox, a list with tick boxes. Feed it. The Tiger normally runs on inspiration, but today it runs on structure and finds it weirdly satisfying.

Around 2 pm, pick one corner of your life, digital or physical, and make it shine. A folder of photos. A drawer of cables. The bookshelf that has been leaning slightly to the left since July. The [[Eight of Pentacles]] hums while working, and you will catch yourself humming too.
joel.mission: Colour-code one thing today, files, books or socks, and show Nancy the rainbow result along with a two-word review of your own work.
joel.omen: A perfectly straight row of anything, fence posts or parked bikes. The tangle you have been dreading quietly combs itself out.

reading: Virgo moons are your secret weapon. Every small inefficiency you have been tolerating will suddenly become unbearable, and you will fix three of them before lunch. Someone will look at your work and ask how you did it so fast. You will just shrug like a magician.

Late afternoon, review Joel's colour-coded masterpiece with the seriousness of a museum curator. Give a grade. Make one suggestion. The Wood Rat sees what others miss, and today that includes the single crooked label he swore was straight. The [[King of Swords]] approves of fair, clear critique.
nancy.mission: Fix three tiny annoyances today, a squeaky hinge, a messy cable, a confusing label, and celebrate each one.
nancy.omen: A crooked picture frame you straighten. A small correction now prevents a big headache later.

together.text: Hold a joint Tidy Hour at the same time today. Thirty minutes each, any space, then share photos. The winner is whoever finds the strangest forgotten object while tidying. Virgo will hand out a very small, very neat gold star.
